name: Surge Reel
about: A burst of flash cuts that hooks, then a calm glowing build, then a quick cinematic finish.
looks: Dark, high-contrast and cinematic. The first seconds are a burst of about ten cuts a second, flipping between black and white frames, in colour-flipped silhouettes and white-on-black technical diagrams. Then the pace drops to one slow, unbroken scene: a single warm light in the dark, with glowing figures appearing one by one on the beat. A short, quicker montage of soft, cloudy and heat-map textures follows, and the video ends on a minimal green line shape on black. Small uppercase corner labels, like a film-lab HUD, stay on screen all the time.
best_for: Teasers, intros, announcements, reels and concept pieces that need a strong first second and a calm, memorable middle. Also a good frame for a short story told in three beats: hook, build, payoff.
good_to_know: The flash start is only about 3 seconds, so it carries one hook idea in words or shapes, never a full explanation. Claude keeps it under a quarter of the video and holds the slow scene for at least 4 seconds.
example_topic: How a pump keeps a factory running through the night
